notes.title: Update 49.1
notes.notes:
Hello!

I've added a UI element that displays collected and pending secrets for each playlist so it's easier for players to focus their exploration to a specific set of levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/6568978587e0c77c35258db898fa1fedc11dcc01.png

Given the number of playlists now and that Green star collectibles don't follow a pattern at all, it's a little bit unfair to expect players to go looking for all the secrets especially towards the end where you're left with 200+ levels to explore for a handful of stars.

Overall, I'm not too happy with the way this system scaled and all the feedback I've received makes a lot of sense. I personally also don't spend a lot of time in games looking for secrets myself, especially when there's so many of them. For legacy reasons, I don't want to remove them now, so I hope this update makes it easier to locate the stars and put the fun back into collecting secrets.

Hope you are all having a great weekend!

Infinite Bliss ✨

notes.title: Hotfix 46.3
notes.notes:
Hello!

Some more fixes for the menu and UI as per feedback from the community.


 We've got mouse support working now for the mode selection screen. You can also use the mouse wheel now to move between the different modes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/fc8da5b21f32bf031719f1e4708a3c1deed23a5e.gif

 The star rating button now allows you to revoke your vote if you feel especially strong about not leaving a rating.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/47d51630ead5a77ff33b8cb570ace78e1d04a478.gif

 Menus are now static and no longer follow the the cursor to avoid the awkward movement when browsing with the mouse cursor. Longer menus are split into multiple columns.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/06a4fe238b3482265429485f8b15c1bc7c113b5a.png

 The close and back buttons have been swapped in the HUD.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/d1f3ace429a89c04c57670b16eac06bed6a6f43d.png

 The Blink X Classic playlists are now under the Blink section in the mode select UI.

 The nickname input field no longer freezes the menu when you hit ESC to cancel.

 Remix Vol. 1X had missing background music which is now fixed.


With the previous improvements in the optimization of the menu, I've reverted the video quality of the thumbnails back to their original size. Hopefully this won't impact the performance too much.

I'm aware that the menu functionality is still lacking in many aspects. The game has a lot more content and features compared to when it first released and not everything is explained clearly. This was all in keeping with the cryptic style of presentation from the original game which doesn't sit well with this game. I want to add tutorials and other text explaining the different modes but I'm currently blocked by localization which I will try to solve next.

Thank you for all the feedback! I'm trying my best to make sure the game is fun and easy to use. Thanks for being patient🙏

Infinite Bliss ✨

I've been preoccupied with content updates so I didn't get time to address this issue earlier. Clunky menus can really take the fun out of moving between levels. I hope this update makes the experience a bit smoother.

notes.title: Hotfix 45.1
notes.notes:
Hi there!

We've got a quick update for Continuity Mode.

The score system works by rewarding players for maintaining a streak and accuracy. That same score dictates the speed of the gameplay and the points you get on the leaderboard. This number is now displayed on the HUD over the Yin Yang ☯ symbol next to the gun.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/bdf0ba13438a24259fdcf2491c78f77054b3c244.gif

The reward system is also simplified. The red star is awarded for a score above 250 and the yellow star for crossing 500. While the score system already rewards players for not wasting bullets and maintaining a 100% accuracy across multiple loops through the playlist is a lot more difficult, I felt it's better to tie the stars to the score directly. I think it's better for this mode to give less importance to a 100% accuracy so players can focus on enjoying the faster gameplay. The leaderboards will not be wiped for now.

Mountains Vol. 2 is almost nearing completion. I'll post another update with new content sometime next week!

Hope you're all having a lovely weekend!

Infinite Bliss ✨

notes.notes:

Got us another quick update with multiple improvements to the visuals and animations.

First up, we have score prompt pop-ups like in the original game. This time they're shiny & colorful blocky models that pop out of the target. While it adds to the noise on the screen, they don't linger on for too long and provide good feedback to hitting enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/ab0b7945661b9395e4c196c6c685b1ade62fd4f7.gif

A new dash vortex animation adds to the feel of being teleported into the target.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/f3fcfc83777471bee763df47927622bb423d4bce.gif

The hands in Blink now track their target before pulling back, unlike before where looking away would move the extended hand away from the target.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/49042b63319216276d0d8b1fe600353c19324d4a.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/24a06bbe092fee46d02b4cd89c923bfd7700a0f4.gif

Subtle tilt animation when hands extend out towards a target.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/ef7a01aec47b4213c09383459f31e23212cc2134.gif

A short twitch animation plays when the hands don't find a target on fire to highlight a missed shot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/454a540771c56f1677b8b899e52dbf6d1585a439.gif

The scroll button in the leaderboard menu is now disabled while waiting for a new page to load. This temporarily fixes the issue where pages would get mixed up when scrolled through too quickly.

That's all for now! I'm working on a new Mountains playlist which will take a while longer. After that I'm excited to work on an original playlist for the Blink X Classic mode with unique levels and maybe new mechanics.

Infinite Bliss ✨

notes.title: Update 42
notes.notes:
Annnndd we're done with the new menus!

New game mode select screen shows all available playlists sorted by game type.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/9d6f47cc57137ee272ddb8a2ee83163b90773612.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/a5dcdcd430814b2554b5db664db6c184187c5f97.jpg

For those of you who prefer to stick to the grid layout, you can quickly press "P" on this menu to skip straight to it instead of scrolling around.

With this update, hopefully I can leave the menus for a little while and start shipping some more new content soon. I have a few ideas for new playlists with a mixup of existing playstyles. I'll be focusing on fleshing out easier levels for players who don't enjoy the more difficult playlists.

Thanks a lot for your continued support! Hope you're enjoying the game! Love you 💖

Update 37 is finally here! Fortress Vol. 2 is now playable with 9 levels and a brand new track on the OST! Infiltrate the heart of the floating fortress under the cover of a stormy night armed with your trusty burst-fire semi-automatic and boots that let you dash through the air!

notes.title: Hotfix 34.4
notes.notes:
Lots of bugs identified, thanks once again to the community on Discord for working out the issues!

Holding the jump button in the Mountains playlist would not reset the jump count on landing so you'd lose the mid-air jump if you're bunny-hopping that way. Fixed.

Levels wouldn't start if the client is on native resolution and the cursor is on the edge of the screen. Also fixed.

If you complete a level on missing an enemy, a small label on the top right hand side of the screen will show your time for that level. I'm thinking to leave this in for now but later a log system or a dashboard for advanced players would be a better feature to have for more detailed information available, perhaps also tie in saving replays locally through that as well.

Cheers!

notes.title: Hotfix 34.3
notes.notes:
Hello,

The experimental targeting system in the Blink playlist that selects targets automatically in-range of the crossahair had a major flaw which changed the targeting as a function of the FoV. That bug has now been fixed.

This is a change that's not backwards compatible so the current scores on the leaderboard for that playlist may or may not be achievable anymore. But, I think those scores can still be beaten so we'll hold off on a playlist-wide hard reset till the Discord decides it's necessary.

The settings menu now alerts the player if they're trying to exit out of the menu without either applying or reverting any unsaved changes.

The field of view of the free cam now aligns with the field of view of the in-game camera.

Some users from select regions were seeing all time displays with comma separators instead of a period. So "4,99" instead of "4.99". This should no longer be an issue.

The start point indicator now shrinks when the Free Cam closes in on it to avoid intersection.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/6cdb18e7d5535e89a292b68a1327565038c8fcdc.gif

Thanks!

notes.title: Hotfix 32.1
notes.notes:
Hey,

Quick hotfix for some issues identified in the last update.

Players attempting to make it to the end point faster by using a dash were not getting consistent results because the hit detection wasn't being done across frames. This wasn't an issue before but shows up in the new Blink playlist because of the faster dashing. This should be fixed now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/723e906e25a29bfa482d8d99974f38d0eea427d6.gif

Players have also reported increased instances of colliders missing on level load, sometimes in the start point or random floors/objects in the level. I haven't been able to identify the source of this issue, but have changed around some settings that could potentially fix or decrease the chances of this happening.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/f9c858859ca213b02cf4f1662d9cc6e648d9f16f.png

It's quite a deal-breaker if it happens mid-speedrun or in Arcade mode because a simple restart doesn't resolve the issue. You have to go back to the main menu and reload the level from scratch. I'll keep investigating this issue to see if I can come up with a better solution. If anyone runs into this issue and would like to help out with troubleshooting, the log file can be found at 

%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Quicktequila\LovelyPlanetRemix\Player.log

Hope everyone's enjoying the new levels!

Merry Christmas!

Cheers

notes.title: Update 30

Weekend update!

You can no longer see through pineapples, straws can be touched, the heart in Jelly Vol. 2 - 1 is not broken anymore and the pools in Tunnels Vol. 1 - 5 are not safe for a casual dip.

This update also exposes data from the executable to allow utilities like AutoSplitter to pick up information about the internal state of the game. We also have a basic .asl script to go along with it that responds to events like start and split which can be easily plugged into LiveSplit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/b885e578218166c62103ece546ae50e8d67e62dd.gif

So if you're speedrunning the game, there's no need to keep track of splits manually with hotkeys. Hop on over to the Discord for the script and more info. I've also added a handy shortcut to the speedrun.com page for the game in the main menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/77205ce3816fb4537f464f57fbf5539fb2b9a5a2.png

Arcade Mode heart pickups no longer persist between levels. If you saw hearts that looked impossible to reach in your Arcade Mode run, that won't happen anymore. For those of you who made any strategies with this bug, my apologies.

Possible fix for a bug where the player would spawn inside the ground and unable to move. Requires further investigation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/3b027c76459c01a3f84d7d16de9e3b4c450df99a.png

Added Spanish support as well. Please let me know if it works okay. Any recommendations on the translations, I'm all ears!

Cheers

notes.title: Update 29 - Localization
notes.notes:
Hello!

I've been working on this since before release and was hoping to push this out sooner but the server issues kept me busy past few days. While sales have been less than stellar, it's always a treat to see players from all over the world pick up the game on launch week. So I thought I'd put in the little extra work to make the game more accessible for everyone.

You can now set the interface language from the settings menu. At the moment we're only supporting Japanese but plan to roll out other EFIGS languages over the next few weeks. This update prepares the internals of the game to support new languages so the rest should follow soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/f30d22b1198dda5afbbfb28ab73587993659a907.gif

The cute curvy font is replaced with a regular rounded Arial which feels a little bit off but I think it fits with the jank retro aesthetic we have going in this game. I'm very particular about consistency and the cutesy aesthetic so this decision wasn't taken lightly. Players with special characters in their nicknames can now see their entry in the leaderboard and all our friends from around the world can navigate the confusing settings menu just a little bit better.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/1a6cb63ba71028e64a19f3241bc39cb46ddfdee5.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/6da7065c75c33f27f9a9b822eef71bebc7b1e1ca.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/f98ca6dcd2be0b4e946895fc64061bdb4e780a6e.png

And of course the localization isn't perfect - if you spot anything that seems off please let me know or jump on the Discord and shout at me there in your language of choice :)

Cheers!

notes.title: Hotfix 28.2
notes.notes:
Server still disconnects. While I work to figure out WHY this keeps happening only for a select few players, I've added a feature for the time being that allows the client to cycle between multiple different services located in different regions around the world every time the connection drops.

This way, if there's a score that is missed, the cache will store it and after hopefully reconnecting to a new service the score and replay will be uploaded successfully.

If you're one of the players who's experiencing this horrible malfunction, my most sincerest apologies. Trying my best to get to the bottom of this issue. Hope this fix helps to save your records at the very least.

Cheers

notes.title: Hotfix 28.1
notes.notes:
Hey,

Back again with a quick hotfix. Mountains Vol. 1 levels 2 & 9 and Jelly Vol. 3 level 4 had qualification times that were impossible to hit with the intended routes.

Replays would bug out if the download takes too long and the user changes the level before it's received from the server so when the replay is started the game would assume it's for the new level that was loaded which would make the game bug out. That issue now fixed - the replay download is ignored/cancelled if the level is changed during the download.

The volume of the SFX for the apple bomb being shot was increased slightly.

Cheers

notes.title: Update 28 - Leaderboard Cache
notes.notes:
After trying out a bunch of tricks to resolve the disconnection issue some players are experiencing, I decided to take a little detour and push a feature that would come in handy not only for those players but anyone that might encounter disconnections or network issues in the future.

The game now maintains a copy of your scores with replays along with your save data if it fails to reach the server. That cache is cleared when the game reconnects and uploads the saved data successfully. It's smart enough to try a reconnect on its own and doesn't overwrite the cache with scores and replays that are slower. For the time being there's no UI for this functionality so all of this will happen under the hood for now.

Apologies for all your scores/times that weren't uploaded. I'll get to the bottom of this for sure, just need some more time. Thank you for your patience and thanks for playing!

Cheers

notes.title: Hotfix 27.9
notes.notes:
Hotfix 27.9

Updated both the client and server to address the issue with connection some users have reported. If you were seeing the "Connection reset by peer" error, try and let me know if it helps. Meanwhile, I'll keep investigating. Also want to make it so that times/replays that were not uploaded due to connection issues are saved locally for later, but that'll be a bit.

This update also addresses an issue with the secret star in Classic Vol. 3 - 3. Said star should now be impossible to reach by means of squeeze alone.

Cheers!

notes.title: Update 26
notes.notes:
Update 26 is Up!

We're inching closer to a release ready build. Anytime now! Lots of fixes in this update. While the leaderboard server only got a light workout during the playtest, we got plenty of feedback on the game iteself so lots of bugs got squashed here. Most noteably, we've finally got a more fleshed out Arcade mode.


 Arcade Mode is now easier to find with a button that appears below the level select menu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/c5c20f69c5663b5f55710f45dbded128b8b97fa1.png

 Level end screens are auto skipped in Arcade Mode

 Arcade Mode progress is now tracked with personal bests and stars earned

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/14c55f2c0ca3d54b10e442e621c4cb8db148e45d.png

 The in-game HUD and level ready/end screens are now context aware and show stats relevant to Arcade Mode

 Fetching leaderboards in Arcade Mode will always pull the Arcade leaderboard for that playlist regardless of which level is currently loaded

 Fixed issue where bullets would clip through geometry when firing from up close.

 Fixed issue with framelimiter value in settings resetting when moving between the menu and game.

 Potential fix for issue where player would slide off slopes easier on lower framerates.

[strike]Tunnels Vol. 1 Level 3 was adjusted to fix an intersection issue at the end point. Leaderboards will be wiped.[/strike] Reverted in 26.1

With this build we're readying to go out of beta so the Beta tag won't show up in the main menu or version numbers from here on out.

Cheers

notes.title: Update 25b
notes.notes:
Update 25b is Live!

You can now switch between multiple profiles and reset your progress in the settings menu! The profiles menu will show your progress and let you set a memorable tag name for each of the 10 available save slots.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40359442/13750e1e81f7ed242fb1138d15dd10747ec4adbd.png

With more menu's stacking up, I also decided to speed up the menu animations because they were causing some minor issues and honestly felt a bit sluggish.

Collectables are still disabled, but more fleshed out now so I'll unwrap this feature again soon.

This update isn't going out on the playtest build. Only available to test for those who have access to the main build. Please note, the profiles feature should be backwards compatible. So your current save will be put into Slot 1 in the profiles menu. If there's any information lost/overwritten, please let me know.

Cheers!

notes.title: Update 19a
notes.notes:
Update 19a is Live!

Plenty of changes here. Minor touch ups to some levels. Changed a few mechanics too!

Figured out an issue with replays when playing with controller. I've got a solution in the works but it's something I'm going to sit on for a while so for now the build no longer uploads replays when controller support is enabled.

For players playing with the keyboard and mouse, you want to make sure the "Controller" option is set to "No" in the settings menu if you want replays to upload to the leaderboard.

This update also uploads all scores to the leaderboard, even if you don't pass the Q time. This is temporary for testing out the backend. Not sure if this'll find its way into the full game.
